note: South Georgia and the South Sandwich Islands, read on the Government of South Georgia and the South Sandwich Islands' Entry Control Order page (gov.gs) on 2026-10-30. Since 1 August 2025 everyone entering for work or a visit, unless exempted, needs an Entry Permit under the Entry Control Ordinance 2022, applied for before arrival through the electronic travel authorisation portal (abroad: the territory has no settled population and no other way in). A work permit is valid six months and may be extended, where justified, by another six; there is no charge for it; the application gives the contract under which the applicant will work, its nature, place and duration (read as work for the sponsor). There is no residence, permanent status or naturalisation beyond the permit.

sources.title: GSGSSI, Entry Control Order – Permit Application
sources.said: entering South Georgia and the South Sandwich Islands for work or visitor purposes will require an Entry Permit.There will be separate permits for work and visitor purposes. ... Under section 6(5) of the Entry Control Ordinance 2022, applications made 14 days or less before the first intended date of arrival may only be accepted where it was not reasonably practicable to apply earlier. ... A work permit is valid for 6 months. Both visitor and work permits can be extended, where justified, for a period of an additional 30 days for visitors and 6 months for a work permit, respectively. ... Details of the contract or other arrangement under which the applicant proposes to work in the Territories ... Work Permits – No charge for a 6-month permit.
